data_fields.name: source_weight
data_fields.donor_constant: civic centre 10000; storehouse 30000; wall 65535; military base 40000

data_fields.name: source_radius
data_fields.donor_constant: civic centre 140; storehouse 20; wall 20; military base 50

data_fields.name: source_root
data_fields.donor_constant: true for civic centre, false for storehouse and wall

best_idea: Zone ownership comes from weighted influence sources with a linear, terrain-cost-scaled falloff over a tile grid; the owner of each tile is the player whose summed weight is greatest, and only tiles connected to a root source count.
decision_why: Take the influence-falloff and max-weight owner shape for zone control, with weight, radius and root as zone data, integer math on the server, and recompute only on source change; the donor's full-map recompute and boundary drawing do not transfer as is.
acceptance: Server test on a 40x3 toy zone grid: one root (weight 10000, radius 140) at tile 2 owns tiles 0-19 and no owner beyond; an exact tie goes to the lower player id; an owned pocket not connected to its root is not counted.
